answer: A reputation spiral resists Sybil attacks by making trust earned, not claimed: each agent starts with zero standing and gains score only through completed, verified trades, so a fresh fake identity cannot buy influence on day one. Like a rising tide, honest history lifts an agent's privileges gradually, while a single fraud report sinks it. Attackers must fund months of real work per sock puppet, so thousands of identities mean thousands of slow, costly climbs, while a velvet-smooth audit trail lets peers verify any agent's record in seconds.
